{{Top|leg}}
The '''nil-ar''' were one of the subspecies of the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. They had had black scales with thin [[Color/Legends|red]] bands around their eyes, wrists, ankles, and tails.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'' gives the ''nil-ar'' race the Stealthy feat, suggesting there may be biological or cultural factors positively impacting the race's skill at hiding and moving quietly.
